AI that understands your business — because it was trained on it.

Kleza fine-tunes large language models on your operational data — clinical notes, internal SOPs, staff communications — producing AI that knows your context, speaks your language, and improves over time.

Assess My AI Readiness See How It Works
The Case for Custom

Generic AI was built for everyone. That’s why it works perfectly for no one.

Every organisation has language, processes, and knowledge that no public training dataset contains. Generic LLMs hallucinate when faced with domain-specific queries because they’ve never encountered your clinical terminology, your care protocols, or your internal escalation workflows. Fine-tuning changes that.

Generic AIKleza-trained AI
Trained on public internet
Trained on your data

The Process

How we build your custom AI model.

01

Data Discovery

We audit your available data sources, assess quality, identify gaps, and flag compliance requirements before any processing begins.

02

Data Preparation

Cleaning, formatting, de-identification (for healthcare), and structuring data into training-ready formats.

03

Architecture Selection

We select the right base model and training approach — fine-tuning, RAG, or a combination — for your specific use case.

04

Training & Iteration

Model training runs with iterative refinement. Domain experts review outputs at key checkpoints.

05

Evaluation & Benchmarking

Accuracy, relevance, and hallucination rate benchmarked against agreed success criteria before any deployment.

06

Deployment & Monitoring

Production deployment with ongoing accuracy monitoring, scheduled retraining cycles, and performance reporting.

Case Study

From 2-week onboarding to 4 days — with AI that knew the job already.

4 days

Onboarding time post-deployment, down from 14 days prior.

Client — CaReBridge
Challenge

New caregiver onboarding took 2 weeks because training materials were scattered across documents and institutional knowledge held by senior staff.

Approach

Kleza trained a custom knowledge assistant on all training materials, SOPs, and recorded Q&A from senior staff. Deployed as a conversational assistant accessible via the onboarding app.

Outcome

Onboarding time reduced from 14 days to 4. New caregivers rated the assistant 4.8/5 for accuracy. Senior staff time freed from repetitive questions.

FAQ

Questions about AI training.

LLM fine-tuning is the process of training a large language model on your specific data — so it learns your terminology, workflows, and context rather than relying on generic public training data. The result is AI that answers domain-specific questions accurately instead of hallucinating plausible-sounding but incorrect responses.

The ideal starting dataset includes operational documentation (SOPs, training materials), communication records, and any structured data your team produces regularly. Kleza conducts a data discovery audit first — we will tell you whether your existing data is sufficient and what gaps exist before any commitment.

All healthcare data is processed under signed Data Processing Agreements and HIPAA-compliant protocols. We de-identify patient data before any training use, use secure isolated environments for training runs, and provide full data handling documentation on request.

A focused AI assistant typically deploys in 6-10 weeks from data discovery to go-live. Full LLM fine-tuning projects range from 8-16 weeks depending on data complexity and evaluation requirements.

Yes — and this combination produces the strongest outcomes. An AI assistant built on a model trained with your data generates more accurate, context-aware responses than one using a generic base model. Ask about our combined AI packages.
